project.name: Primitive
release_notes: TimeMatch availability is free/busy only: Apple uses the CalDAV free-busy-query report (VFREEBUSY periods; a refusal, other media or any event component leaves the calendar Unknown, never an event download), replacing the calendar-query/calendar-data path of 457 and 458.

Google visitor consent is calendar.events.freebusy alone on the primary calendar; confirming an appointment is a separate calendar.events.owned consent. Microsoft calendarView selects only start, end, showAs, isCancelled and isAllDay and gains the primary default-calendar path.
